results.use_case: Set up a HubSpot workflow that is initially turned off
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if avoiding duplicates/cloning)] [Prerequisite]: Audit existing automations using HUBSPOT_GET_WORKFLOWS (confirm naming/ownership and reuse opportunities).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the integration has required permissions using HUBSPOT_LIST_GRANTED_SCOPES (ensure automation scopes exist before workflow writes).
[Optional (if copying a known-good action schema for email/delay actions)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect a reference workflow using HUBSPOT_GET_WORKFLOW_BY_ID (note actionTypeId and exact fields shape).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm valid internal property names using HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE (prevent enrollment/action property mismatches).
[Required] [Step]: Design workflow metadata and create it using HUBSPOT_CREATE_WORKFLOW (contacts objectTypeId, enrollmentCriteria, actions, isEnabled).
[Optional (for post-create inspection)] [Next Step]: Verify persisted action graph/order using HUBSPOT_GET_WORKFLOW_BY_ID (catch schema/connection issues early).
[Required] [Next Step]: Validate enrollment filters by previewing matches using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA (page through results before concluding targeting is correct).
[Optional (if criteria looks incomplete)] [Next Step]: Spot-check property coverage by paging/browsing contacts using HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACTS (verify fields used in enrollmentCriteria are populated).
[Required (if workflow depends on pre-setting/scoring fields)] [Next Step]: Apply programmatic property changes using HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CONTACT (keep updates idempotent and scoped to enrolled records).
[Required] [Fallback]: If workflow creation fails with missing permissions, re-check scopes using HUBSPOT_LIST_GRANTED_SCOPES (resolve MISSING_SCOPES before retrying).
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_CREATE_WORKFLOW] 403 Forbidden with category="MISSING_SCOPES" when automation scopes aren’t granted; confirm via HUBSPOT_LIST_GRANTED_SCOPES before retrying.
[HUBSPOT_CREATE_WORKFLOW] 400 validation errors if actions[].fields is sent as an array—fields must be a map/object; enrollmentCriteria branch/type shapes are strict.

[HUBSPOT_CREATE_WORKFLOW] Delay action field schema can trigger opaque 500 Internal Server Error if using fields.delayMillis (even with type changes); working workflows used fields.delta + fields.time_unit.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Filters in a group are ANDed and groups are ORed; incorrect grouping yields unexpected enrollment/empty results.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Paginated results; iterate limit/after until exhaustion before concluding criteria only matches the first page.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_WORKFLOW.description: Creates a new HubSpot workflow to automate processes; ensure `enrollmentCriteria` and `actions` use properties relevant to the specified `objectTypeId`.

name.description: The unique name for the workflow.

type.description: 'CONTACT_FLOW' for contact-based workflows, 'PLATFORM_FLOW' for workflows based on other CRM object types (deals, companies, tickets, custom objects).

actions.description: Array of workflow action configurations. Each action must include: 'actionId' (unique string ID), 'type' (e.g., 'SINGLE_CONNECTION'), 'actionTypeId' (e.g., '0-1' for delay, '0-4' for email), 'actionTypeVersion' (typically 0), 'connection' (object with 'edgeType' and 'nextActionId'), and 'fields' (action-specific settings). Example: [{'actionId': '1', 'type': 'SINGLE_CONNECTION', 'actionTypeId': '0-1', 'actionTypeVersion': 0, 'connection': {'edgeType': 'STANDARD', 'nextActionId': '2'}, 'fields': {'delayMillis': 3600000}}]

flowType.description: Flow category: 'WORKFLOW' for standard workflows, 'ACTION_SET' for reusable action sets that can be called from other workflows.

isEnabled.description: Set to true to activate the workflow immediately upon creation, or false to create it in disabled state for review.

dataSources.description: Data source configurations for conditions or personalization.

examples: This workflow nurtures new leads acquired through the Q1 campaign.
description.description: Optional explanation of the workflow's purpose and functionality.

timeWindows.description: Configurations for periods when workflow actions can execute.

blockedDates.description: Configurations for dates when workflow actions should not execute.

objectTypeId.description: HubSpot internal ID for the CRM object type: '0-1' for Contacts, '0-2' for Companies, '0-3' for Deals, '0-5' for Tickets, or custom object type ID.

startActionId.description: The unique ID of the first action in the workflow. This must match the actionId of one of the actions in the actions array.

customProperties.description: Custom key-value pairs for organization or tracking.

enrollmentCriteria.description: Required configuration defining enrollment triggers for the workflow. Must include: 'type' (either 'EVENT_BASED' or 'LIST_BASED'), 'shouldReEnroll' (boolean for allowing re-enrollment), and either 'eventFilterBranches' (for event-based) or 'listFilterBranch' (for list-based enrollment). Example for event-based: {'type': 'EVENT_BASED', 'shouldReEnroll': false, 'eventFilterBranches': [{'filterBranchType': 'OR', 'filterBranchOperator': 'OR', 'filters': [{'filterType': 'PROPERTY', 'property': 'email', 'operator': 'HAS_PROPERTY'}]}]}

suppressionListIds.description: HubSpot list IDs for contacts to be prevented from enrollment.

type.description: Unenrollment behavior: 'ALL' from all other workflows, 'SELECTIVE' from specified workflows.

flowIds.description: Workflow IDs for unenrollment if 'type' is 'SELECTIVE'.

unEnrollmentSetting.description: Defines if/how objects unenroll from other workflows upon enrolling in this one.

nextAvailableActionId.description: The next available action ID number for sequencing. This should be one higher than the highest action ID number used in the workflow.

canEnrollFromSalesforce.description: Allow contacts to be enrolled directly from Salesforce.

HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA.description: Searches for HubSpot contacts using a text query, specific filter criteria (filters in a group are ANDed, groups are ORed), sorting, and pagination to retrieve selected properties.

after.description: The cursor token for pagination. Use the `after` value from the `paging.next` object of a previous response to fetch the next set of results. If `None` or an empty string, it fetches the first page.

limit.description: The maximum number of contacts to return.

query.description: A string to search across HubSpot's default searchable contact properties ONLY: firstname, lastname, email, phone, hs_additional_emails, hs_object_id, hs_searchable_calculated_phone_number, company. IMPORTANT: This does NOT search custom properties. To search/filter by custom properties (e.g., 'icp_segment', 'lead_source'), use filterGroups with specific property filters instead. At least one of 'query' or 'filterGroups' must be provided.

direction.description: The direction for sorting (`ASCENDING` or `DESCENDING`). See `DirectionEnm` for options.

propertyName.description: The HubSpot contact property to sort by. Supports both standard and custom property internal names.

items.description: Defines a sorting criterion for search results, including the property name and sort direction.

sorts.description: A list of sort criteria to apply. Each criterion specifies a contact `propertyName` and a sort `direction`. Example: `[{'propertyName': 'lastname', 'direction': 'ASCENDING'}]` sorts contacts by last name.

properties.description: A list of contact property internal names to include in the response. Supports both standard properties (firstname, email, etc.) and custom properties. If omitted, a default set is returned.

value.description: The value to compare the property against. Required for most operators (e.g., `EQ`, `LT`). Must NOT be set with `IN`, `NOT_IN`, `HAS_PROPERTY`, `NOT_HAS_PROPERTY` operators. For datetime properties (createdate, lastmodifieddate, etc.), use epoch milliseconds (e.g., '1609459200000'). Relative time strings like '24h', '7d', '24 hours ago' are automatically converted to epoch milliseconds.

values.description: A list of values for `IN` or `NOT_IN` operations. Required and only used when `operator` is `IN` or `NOT_IN`. Maximum 100 values allowed per filter (HubSpot API constraint). If you need more than 100 values, split into multiple filter groups (groups are ORed, preserving the logic).

operator.description: The operator to use for filtering (e.g., `EQ`, `NEQ`, `LT`, `BETWEEN`, `IN`). Determines how the `propertyName` is compared with `value`, `values`, or `highValue`. See `OperatorEnm` for all options.

highValue.description: The higher bound value for a `BETWEEN` operation. Required and only used when `operator` is `BETWEEN`.

propertyName.description: The HubSpot contact property to filter on. Supports both standard properties (email, lifecyclestage, etc.) and custom properties. IMPORTANT: To filter by contact ID, use 'hs_object_id' (not 'id').

items.description: Represents a single filter criterion for searching contacts, specifying a property, operator, and value(s).

filters.description: A list of filter criteria objects. All filters within this list are combined using AND logic.

items.description: Defines a group of filters. Filters within a group are ANDed. Multiple filter groups in a search request are ORed.

filterGroups.description: A list of filter groups. HubSpot enforces strict limits: maximum 5 filterGroups and maximum 18 total filters across all groups combined. Filters within a group are ANDed. Multiple groups are ORed. Use filterGroups to search/filter by ANY property (including custom properties) with precise operators. At least one of 'query' or 'filterGroups' must be provided. For custom property filtering (e.g., icp_segment='Construction'), use filterGroups instead of query. Example: `[{'filters': [{'propertyName': 'icp_segment', 'operator': 'EQ', 'value': 'Construction'}]}]`. If you need more filter groups or filters, split your search into multiple requests.

custom_properties.description: A list of internal names for custom contact properties to retrieve (e.g., `custom_lead_score`). This is a convenience alias that gets merged into `properties` before the API call - you can also include custom properties directly in the `properties` field instead.

HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CONTACT.description: Updates properties for an existing HubSpot contact.

contactId.description: Unique HubSpot identifier for the contact to be partially updated. Can also be provided as 'contact_id' (snake_case).

email.description: Primary email address (HubSpot unique identifier by default).

message.description: General message/note, often from form submission.

numemployees.description: Number of employees in company (numeric value as string).

annualrevenue.description: Annual revenue (numeric value stored as string).

hs_lead_status.description: Lead status. Valid values: NEW, OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, OPEN_DEAL, UNQUALIFIED, ATTEMPTED_TO_CONTACT, CONNECTED, BAD_TIMING.

lifecyclestage.description: Current lifecycle stage. Valid values: subscriber, lead, marketingqualifiedlead, salesqualifiedlead, opportunity, customer, evangelist, other.

hubspot_owner_id.description: ID of the HubSpot user owning this contact.

properties.description: Standard HubSpot contact properties. Use these for common contact fields.

custom_properties.description: Custom HubSpot properties to update. Use this for any custom properties you've created in your HubSpot account. Keys must be the internal property names (e.g., 'my_custom_field'). Values must be strings. Use HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACT_PROPERTIES with custom_only=true to discover available custom property names. These are merged with standard properties before sending to the API.

HUBSPOT_GET_WORKFLOWS.description: Retrieves a list of workflow summaries (ID, name, type, status) from HubSpot, using the 'limit' parameter for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of workflows to retrieve per API call, used for pagination.

HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACTS.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot contacts.
